context: Successful SaaS company. Pre-pandemic: 100% office. Post-pandemic: hybrid. Current: 70% office, 30% hybrid. Leadership divided on remote work. Some employees relocated during pandemic.
external_context: Tech talent market is highly competitive. Remote work is becoming standard in industry. Some enterprise customers prefer in-person relationships.
culture: Historically hierarchical, but trying to be more agile. Strong coffee-culture (office-based socializing). Some technical silos between teams.

groups.name: C-Suite & Directors
groups.typical_narrative: We need to preserve our culture. Remote work might hurt collaboration with clients. We should stay in the office.

groups.name: Senior Engineers
groups.typical_narrative: Remote work helps us focus, but we lose hallway conversations. Hybrid might be the answer. Full remote is risky.

groups.name: Mid-level Managers
groups.typical_narrative: How do we manage remote teams? How do we know people are working? This is scary.

groups.name: Individual Contributors (Junior)
groups.typical_narrative: Remote work is great! We get to work from anywhere, no commute. This is what we want.

groups.name: Operations & Support
groups.typical_narrative: We depend on being in the office for our work. How does this apply to us? What about the office pets? Will we still have community?

groups.name: Sales & Account Managers
groups.typical_narrative: We already work from the road and from client offices. Remote makes sense for us. But some clients like in-person meetings.
